scope: Theorem 7.1 (Exponential-profile obstruction) of the manuscript “Rigidity of Smooth Billiards with a Continuous Caustic Collar” (preprints/Rigidity-of-Smooth-Billiards-with-a-Continuous-Caustic-Collar-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 147 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0fefc18481d52acb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 70. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is no sequence of centers sn = xn+ihn ∈ DH, length scales ℓn > 0, and field scales mn > 0 with the following properties. Put bn = ℓnmn and Fn(S) = f(sn + ℓnS) mn , Qn(S) = q(sn + ℓnS) m2 n , Y = y − sn ℓn , T = mnt. (7.1) Assume that bn → ∞, that (DH − sn)/ℓn exhausts C, and that, locally uniformly on C, either (Fn, Qn) −→ (c0e−iS , 0) or (Fn, Qn) −→ (0, c2 0e−2iS ), c0 ̸= 0. (7.2) The following additional assumptions are imposed according to the value of H. (i) If H < ∞, then hn → H, ℓn → 0, and there are α0 ∈ (1/2, 1) and δb ∈ (0, H/2) such that, for every fixed L < ∞, there is a constant CL for which eventually M(s) ≤ CLmn  ℓn δ α0 , ℓn ≤ δ = hn − ℑs ≤ δb, |ℜs − xn| ≤ Lδ. (7.3) The exponent is independent of L; the constant and the eventual sequence threshold may depend on L. (ii) If H = ∞, then hn → ∞, 0 < ℓn ≤ C, and (7.3) holds with a single constant for all horizontal positions and for ℓn ≤ δ ≤ hn. Moreover, log(1 + hn/ℓn) = o(log mn). (7.4)
